newsitem.title: USA: Millennium to take Q2 gain from settlement.
newsitem.headline: Millennium to take Q2 gain from settlement.

text.p: Millennium Petrochemicals Inc said Wednesday it will receive $49 million in additional payment to cover property damages suffered after a 1989 plant explosion.

Millennium, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Millennium Chemicals Inc, said the payment will generate a one-time, non- operating gain of about $0.36 a share for Millennium Chemicals in the second quarter of 1997.
It said it was going to get the $49 million during the next two months.
The amount is the balance of the coverage that it had sought to cover for business interruption after an explosion and fire at its Morris, Illinois plant in 1989, it said.
Millennium said it settled its property damage insurance claims in 1992, receiving a partial payment of $34.6 million the following year.
The net proceeds will be used for debt reduction and general corporate purposes, it said.
Millennium is a chemical company, while Millennium Chemicals is a polyethylene products maker.
